headline: Weathered Expanse and Nevish Line Ignite as Central Strongpoints Crumble
war_summary: Since the mid-afternoon dispatch, severe combat has reignited across the northern lines. The Weathered Expanse erupted with three fresh base turnovers in the past two hours, swelling its casualty count by over three thousand fallen soldiers and leaving three strategic hubs in ruined neutrality. To the northwest, Nevish Line broke into open instability with two rapid base actions at the wire, leaving one strongpoint desolate amid fierce head-on clashes. Marban Hollow surrendered another bastion to no-man's-land, reducing the line to three Warden garrisons, three Colonial positions, and two vacant ruins following two further exchanges. Stonecradle also witnessed renewed fighting as The Reach changed hands twice in the last two hours, breaking its relative calm. By contrast, previous flashpoints at Kuura Strand, Mooring County, and Stlican Shelf have largely quieted, recording no territorial changes since the afternoon. Linn of Mercy endures staggering butchery—yielding over three thousand casualties in two hours without a fresh parapet falling—while Callahan's Passage remains locked in grinding, static slaughter.
